title: 第17章 认输我不同意第18章 说杀就杀
content_zh:
第17章认输？我不同意！
剑光闪过，几乎一瞬之间。
李星打出来的七枚魄银针，同时掉落在地上，一个个皆是断成两段。
“这是什么剑术！
如此恐怖，竟然足以斩断魄银针？”
人群之中，窃窃私语起来。
这魄银针，打出去后，一秒便是足以飞出百米，寻常淬骨境灵师，想要躲开都是极难，又如何能够以剑斩断。
这等剑术，简直惊为天人，就算是有些剑修强者，都不一定足以斩断这魄银针吧。
在场也都是些武者，自然懂得这其中的艰难。
在一旁的一名年轻男子，也是愣了愣，虽然他的脸色便是难堪了起来。
“该死！
这小杂种怎么会有如此恐怖的剑术！
难道是那个老不死教给他的！”
年轻男子低声怒吼道，声音虽然低，但是还是吓了周围人一跳。
“少府主，不用担心，李星的实力还在这楚风眠之上，这楚风眠今日必死无疑。”
旁边一名林府弟子急忙劝解讨好到。
“滚！”
年轻男子怒吼道，这一句话直接便是马屁拍错了。
如今楚风眠展现出这等剑术，那李星，就算是实力比起楚风眠境界要高，也不可能是楚风眠的对手了。
毕竟这等剑术实在是太过恐怖，两重境界，也无法压倒。

除非李星全力一搏，不然的话，丝毫没有机会。
“不行！
决不能让这小杂种在活下去！”
年轻男子心中恶狠狠的想到。
楚风眠成为武者的时间，不过几日，就算是之前楚风眠有着隐藏，时间也不会很长。
短短的时间之中，楚风眠的剑术都可以达到如此恐怖的程度，若是让楚风眠在继续成长下来，绝对又是一位恐怖天才的诞生。
倒时候这林府少府主之位到底是谁，可就说不准了。
要知道楚风眠的爷爷，便就是林府上一代的府主，要是楚风眠真的成长起来，在林府之中也肯定会有人来选择支持楚风眠的。
“本以为这小杂种是个废物，没想到倒是看走了眼，不过还好，还未成长起来，早晚有机会将他灭杀！”
年轻男子心中一边阴狠想到，一边又是将视线转向生死台上。
看到魄银针被斩断的一刻，李星的脸色瞬间之间变得惨白。
他本以为利用魄银针偷袭楚风眠，就算是楚风眠侥幸挡住，也至少也要被刺入几根进去，倒时候魄银针发作，楚风眠还不是任他宰割。
可现在楚风眠突然出剑，将魄银针全部斩断，这等剑术，就算他并非是一位剑修，也可以懂得，其中到底多难。
李星看着一步步逼近他的楚风眠，他的心中已经是被恐惧所充斥。
这等剑术，他又如何能有勇气抗衡。
“楚风眠，我认输。”
李星大口喘着气，突然开口道。
“这次我认输，如何？从此外府第一人的位置，便是归你。”
李星的这句话，顿时周围人群便是一阵哗然。
认输。

李星，那是林府外府年轻一代的第一人，论起实力，在內府之中都算是中上游，如今竟然是选择认输了。
content_en:
Chapter 17: Admit defeat? I disagree!
The sword light flashed, almost instantly.
The seven soul silver needles shot by Li Xing fell to the ground at the same time, and each one was broken into two pieces.
"What kind of swordsmanship is this!
It's so terrifying that it's enough to cut off the Soul Silver Needle? "
Among the crowd, whispers began.
This soul silver needle can fly hundreds of meters in one second after it is shot out. It is extremely difficult for an ordinary bone-tempering realm spiritual master to avoid it, so how can he cut it off with a sword.
This kind of swordsmanship is simply amazing. Even some strong swordsmen may not be able to cut off this silver needle.
There are also some warriors present, so they naturally understand the difficulty involved.
A young man on the side was also stunned, although his expression became embarrassed.
"Damn it!
How could this little bastard have such terrifying swordsmanship!
Could it be that the old immortal taught him this? "
The young man roared in a low voice. Although his voice was low, it still startled the people around him.
"Young Master, don't worry. Li Xing's strength is still higher than that of Chu Fengmian. Chu Fengmian will definitely die today."
A disciple from the Lin Mansion next to him hurriedly tried to persuade him to please him.
"Get out!"
The young man roared angrily. This sentence was a direct flattery.
Now that Chu Fengmian has shown such swordsmanship, Li Xing, even if his strength is higher than that of Chu Fengmian, cannot be Chu Fengmian's opponent.
After all, this level of swordsmanship is too terrifying, and even two realms cannot overwhelm it.
Unless Li Xing tries his best, there is no chance at all.
"No!
This little bastard must not be allowed to live! "
The young man thought fiercely in his heart.
It only took a few days for Chu Fengmian to become a warrior. Even if Chu Fengmian had hidden something before, it would not last long.
In a short period of time, Chu Fengmian's swordsmanship has reached such a terrifying level. If Chu Fengmian continues to grow, another terrifying genius will definitely be born.
At this time, it is not clear who the young master of the Lin Mansion is.
You must know that Chu Fengmian's grandfather was the previous generation master of the Lin Mansion. If Chu Fengmian really grew up, there would definitely be someone in the Lin Mansion who would choose to support Chu Fengmian.
"I thought this little bastard was a waste, but I misjudged him. But fortunately, he hasn't grown up yet. Sooner or later, I will have a chance to kill him!"
The young man thought sinisterly in his heart and turned his attention to the stage of life and death.
The moment he saw the Soul Silver Needle being cut off, Li Xing's face instantly turned pale.
He originally thought that he would use the Soul Silver Needles to sneak attack Chu Fengmian. Even if Chu Fengmian was lucky enough to block it, at least a few of them would be pierced. However, when the Soul Silver Needles struck, Chu Fengmian was not at his mercy.
But now Chu Fengmian suddenly drew his sword and cut off all the Soul Silver Needles. Even if he was not a swordsman with this kind of swordsmanship, he could understand how difficult it was.
Li Xing looked at Chu Fengmian who was approaching him step by step, and his heart was already filled with fear.
How could he have the courage to compete with such sword skills?
"Chu Fengmian, I admit defeat."
Li Xing gasped for air and suddenly said.
"How about I admit defeat this time? From now on, the position of number one in this mansion belongs to you."
Li Xing's words immediately caused an uproar among the surrounding people.
Throw in the towel.
Li Xing, who was the number one member of the younger generation in the Lin Mansion's Outer Mansion, was considered to be in the middle or upper reaches of the Inner Mansion in terms of strength, but now he actually chose to admit defeat.
